description: Header file defining SDL utility functions, surface management, and related graphics operations for the Wesnoth game project.

classes.name: surface
classes.description: Wrapper class for SDL_Surface with reference counting and resource management.

classes.name: pixel_data
classes.description: Structure for handling pixel color data and conversions.
